checks.description: Existing Admin route initializes successfully.
All existing template rows remain in the original model.
Two dedicated quality templates appear in the same table as existing rows.
Both channel templates initially remain disabled.
Unified list preserves the six observed columns and actual five-record count.
Main list uses Chinese scenes, hides technical IDs, and provides shared-rule and create controls.
All-scene filter can show only the enterprise-WeChat daily template.
Clearing the scene filter restores all original and daily templates.
Existing template editor still opens through Admin.edit.
Existing template editor exposes its original name field.
Cancelling the old template editor leaves its record unchanged.
Existing edit form remains valid for a local save.
Existing template save updates its own original row.
Quality controls survive the existing list refresh.
Create keeps the existing generic template form.
Legacy create appears alongside both daily templates with the actual count.
Legacy delete restores three original records without deleting daily templates.
Existing template save uses its original scoped storage key.
Daily editor follows the observed scene, timing, model, name and content order.
Daily advanced workflow starts collapsed and footer keeps Confirm and Cancel.
Model options use only enabled scene-compatible candidates with source scope and optional default.
Delayed close events from prior editors do not clear the new editor state.
Edited prompt is marked unsaved and cannot publish.
Shell scrim close message preserves dirty editor and offers leave choices.
Legacy direct close entry also respects the quality editor dirty guard.
Saving a prompt only saves its draft.
Saving one channel leaves the other published template unchanged.
Failed trial displays a failure and blocks publication.
Passing same-channel trial allows the saved candidate to publish.
Changes after trial clear its visible proof and block publication.
Saved changes invalidate previous trial in the shared model.
Publishing enables only the chosen channel and increments its version.
Storage failure retains unsaved edits and original stored draft.
Escape cannot discard dirty prompt edits.
Continue editing preserves the dirty content.
Close button also guards unsaved edits.
Saving a draft before leaving resolves navigation and closes the editor.
Save-and-leave does not publish the pending prompt.
Continue editing declines a Shell leave request.
Discard leaves without changing the already saved draft.
Both channel templates can be enabled independently.
Shared-rule draft is one source and leaves current rule unchanged.
Shared-rule changes invalidate both channel prompt trials.
One successful channel cannot publish rules when both are enabled.
A failed second-channel trial keeps old common rules effective.
Both exact candidate trials permit shared-rule publication.
One shared publish changes both rule references to the same version.
Shared rules do not replace either dedicated template version.
Previously generated report retains its original rule snapshot.
Quality workflows do not mutate original template storage.
Confirm preserves an empty binding and shows its scene default.
Default-bound publication records the shared directory final model.
Simulated platform model change refreshes candidates but preserves unsaved content.
An unavailable default fails visibly and does not silently choose another enabled model.
Empty model candidates explain platform configuration and expose the read-only directory link.
Model-directory navigation uses the existing enterprise-model route and same origin.
Default and directory tests still leave legacy storage and old report snapshots untouched.
Corrupt channel storage shows an error instead of a false empty state.
One corrupt channel preserves the other controls and the original list.
No unexpected jsdom runtime errors occurred.

boundaries.storage: Fresh in-memory jsdom localStorage; no existing browser data read or modified.
boundaries.visualVerification: Not performed by this check; actual Chrome verification is separate.
boundaries.coverage: Existing Admin template render/edit plus quality prompt and shared-rule interaction.
